title: Sandlords Scimitar
html:
Source not yet observed

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Sword weapon skill. Warriors start with it. Everyone else can study a Sword tome (1 skill point; vendors no longer sell them, so look on the Exchange).

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Unique. Dropped by Sandlord Azhar on 1% of kills (5% from an elite). Built on Titanium Scimitar. Unique items can’t be reforged.

  • 15% of hits corrode the target's armor.

See Unique items for all of them.

No monster drops recorded for this item.
